interlocks.cause: Guard door opened or not closed (ZS-3002 / X32 is OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits test start and immediately removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain not healthy (ES-0001 / X0 is OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits test start and immediately removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: Pallet not in position in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33 is OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits test start, keeping HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31) de-energized

interlocks.cause: Test result latched (PASS M310 or FAIL M311 is ON)
interlocks.effect: Removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and turns off HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33)
interlocks.effect: Resets latched PASS (M310) and FAIL (M311) test results

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet leaves ST30 (ZS-3001 falling edge resets results)
steps.exit: Pallet in position (ZS-3001), guard door closed (ZS-3002), and E-stop chain healthy (ES-0001)
steps.name: Idle

steps.entry: Pallet in ST30 (ZS-3001), guard door closed (ZS-3002), E-stop healthy (ES-0001), and no result latched (M310 and M311 clear)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003) or FAIL (HP-3004), guard door opened (ZS-3002 lost), or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001 lost)
steps.name: HiPot Test

steps.entry: Tester PASS (HP-3003) or FAIL (HP-3004) received and latched in M310 or M311, removing HV enable (HP-3005)
steps.name: Result Latched
